At enrollment, a kiosk shows a random quill glyph, projects a moving dune pattern across the applicant's face, and records a fingertip pulse.

The verifier checks stroke timing, 3-D light response, and pulse liveness, then searches a salted biometric commitment for prior enrollment and issues one unlinkable nullifier.

A puppet needs a different live person to repeat the full paid session; N puppets require N people, appointments, and fees with no bulk discount, while an honest user pays once.
